name: Java 17 + Maven Dev Container
postCreateCommand: sh -lc 'if [ -f /workspace/mvnw ]; then chmod +x /workspace/mvnw && /workspace/mvnw -B -DskipTests=true clean compile; elif [ -f /workspace/lab1/mvnw ]; then cd /workspace/lab1 && chmod +x mvnw && ./mvnw -B -DskipTests=true clean compile; elif [ -f /workspace/pom.xml ]; then mvn -B -DskipTests=true clean compile; elif [ -f /workspace/lab1/pom.xml ]; then cd /workspace/lab1 && mvn -B -DskipTests=true clean compile; else echo "No pom.xml found - skipping auto build"; fi'
postStartCommand: sh -lc 'if [ ! -d /home/vscode/.m2/repository ]; then sudo mkdir -p /home/vscode/.m2/repository 2>/dev/null || true; sudo chown -R $(id -u vscode):$(id -g vscode) /home/vscode/.m2 2>/dev/null || chmod -R 0777 /home/vscode/.m2 2>/dev/null; fi'
